The '''Brujah''' are one of the thirteen [[Clan (VTM)|clans]] of Kindred.

==Overview==
Fighters against the system, rebels against injustice.

==Weaknesses==
====Banes====
*'''Violent Temper''': All difficulties to resist Frenzy increase by two.
*Variant — '''Violence''': A messy critical inflicts Aggravated damage.

===Compulsion===
'''Rebellion''': the vampire takes a stand against the status quo until they have gone against orders.
